rows.title: The Evil Dead: The horror shocker that set off a culture war
rows.dek_lead: As the latest Evil Dead film is released, promising more demonic possession and extreme gore, nothing will beat the provocative power of the original, writes Adam Scovell. "The ultimate experience in gruelling horror": so suggests
